children: Cineverse entered into a secured term loan of up to $3.125 million with BondIt to fund the re-release and 3D conversion of "Pan's Labyrinth" and to repay a portion of its East West Bank facility. The company also executed a capped $2.344 million guaranty in favor of BondIt, subordinated to the East West Bank credit facility. The loan matures Oct 26, 2027, carries a $179,000 minimum interest commitment through seven months post-closing, then 1.39% monthly interest, and includes a post-repayment 11.25% royalty on specified receipts until BondIt has received up to 1.75x principal and interest.
